title: Backdoor Channels Hidden in Latent Space: Extending Cryptographic Undetectability to Modern Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2605.13214v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent cryptographic results establish that neural networks can be backdoored such that no efficient algorithm can distinguish them from a clean model. These guarantees, however, have been confined to stylised architectures of limited practical relevance, leaving open whether comparable undetectability extends to modern, end-to-end trained networks. We construct such an attack mechanism for state-of-the-art architectures, closely aligned to the cryptographic notion of undetectability, by identifying backdoor channels as learned latent directions, and show that the question of undetectability reduces to a hypothesis test between two unknown distributions over model parameters, which we conjecture to be intractable in practice. translated_title: 潜藏在潜空间中的后门通道：将密码学不可检测性扩展到现代神经网络
translated_abstract: 近期的密码学研究成果表明，神经网络可以被植入后门，使得任何高效算法都无法将其与干净模型区分开来。然而，这些保障一直局限于实际相关性有限的程式化架构，留下了这样一个悬而未决的问题：同等的不可检测性能否扩展到现代端到端训练的网络中。我们通过将后门通道识别为学习到的潜在方向，为最先进的架构构建了这样一种攻击机制，该机制与密码学意义上的不可检测性高度一致，并证明不可检测性问题可归结为对模型参数上两个未知分布之间的假设检验——我们推测该问题在实践中是难以处理的。这一重新表述的意义重大：如果网络潜空间中可利用的通道在统计上与自然学习到的方向无法区分，攻击者便无需引入（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文通过将后门通道识别为网络潜空间中学习到的潜在方向，把密码学意义上的不可检测后门攻击扩展到现代端到端训练的最先进神经网络，并证明其检测问题可归结为一个在实践中难以处理的假设检验。
en_tdlr: This paper extends cryptographically undetectable backdoor attacks to modern end-to-end trained neural networks by identifying backdoor channels as learned latent directions, showing that detecting them reduces to a hypothesis test conjectured to be intractable in practice.
